title: CBeebies legend Mr Tumble announces new job just WEEKS after stepping back from hit show following 20 years on air
text:
The legend of Cbeebies, Mr. Tumble, announced his new role, weeks after leaving the program.
Tumble, the dear character played by Justin Fletcher, 54, has been a favorite of fans on the BBC screens for more than 20 years as the only host of something special.
Earlier this year, it was revealed that Justin would take a step back from the full -time program, with three coanfitations that joined him to share the workload.
Now, only a few weeks after that announcement, it has been revealed that Justin has achieved a new role, and spectators can get involved!
For the first time in three years, Justin will go on tour, throwing Justin Time to Rock’s shows this October in Bromley.
Although the dates of the tour are currently announced until November, Justin promises to remain on the road to the spring of 2026. Tickets for most shows are expected to go on sale tomorrow.

Speaking of going to the road once again, Justin said: “I am very excited to go on tour this year in our new Justin Time To Rock program.”
“We really enjoy traveling around the country, making our shows and meeting so many friends.”
“We cannot wait to build the band, dance and sing some fabulous party songs.”
A teaser synopsis for the program says: “Justin and his friends are organizing a rock band.”
“But with so many songs to choose from, they will need their help to choose the best songs to sing and dance.”
Justin’s Something Special has become one of the most popular BBC children’s programs.
The program, which is transmitted in Cbeebies, uses signs of Makaton, speeches and symbols to help children communicate and develop their linguistic skills in a fun and exciting way.
In a great shake that will change the program forever, the new special series will see Justin joined by two additional presenters: Maddie Moate and Ben Caee, with George Webster also join along the series.

Maddie television presenter – Who is known for presenting the Cbeebies do You Know program? – I took Instagram last month to share the exciting news.
Together with a selfie with Mr. Tumble, she on the set and with the rest of the crew, she wrote: “Last year I was lucky to be part of something special … the” something special “, now in her 14th series, starring the very beloved, Mr Tumble and Justin Fletcher!
“For anyone who is not familiar with the program, something special is a children’s television program that uses signs, speeches and symbols of @Makaton to help children learn how to communicate and develop their linguistic skills in a fun and exciting way “
“The new series remains the same happy and cozy place (with many Mr Tumble!), But with the addition of some friendly and relatives of Cbeebies!”
‘@Ben_Caje and I all joined the team and had the opportunity to guide the children while looking for clues and tried to find their irregular surprise.
“I can’t even start sharing my gratitude and astonishment from the production team behind this program.”
“The amount of love and care that makes filming the most cheerful experience for children is inspiring.”
‘This program is the transmission of public services at its best. Children are always the first, and they should.
“The program would not exist without all our wonderful taxpayers and all their families.”

Maddie won the Bafta Children’s Awards for the best presenter in 2017.
Meanwhile, Ben, who has worked in Cbeebes since 2015, also resorted to its social media page to open about the exciting company.
Ben wrote: “I obtained the wink to be part of the new presentation line in something special.”
‘When I was younger, apart from opening the batting for England or running the center of the West Ham field, I didn’t know what I wanted to do for work. That is still the case now.
“I thought it would be great to be in sport, with children and transmission, and feel lucky to be able to do those things.”
“This iconic show is entering its 14th season and the legacy and responsibility of these children and the audience has not been lost.”
“I will always do everything possible and promise to take care of the show and, hopefully, do justice, both now and in the future.”
‘The first episode falls on my birthday, Monday, January 13. Ironic. I appreciate the gift and the opportunity.
